svg.text: Matriarch-class mothership · 7,200 × 1,360 × 900 m · orthographic views at true scale from the Master Specification, Rev 152 · radiators stowed
bow to the left; port at the top
nested collars stepping down to the cap
squared frame shadowing five drive throats in an X
From the spec: length, beam, height, section stations (cap 0–500, three collars to 1,200, full section to 5,300, aft step-down, engine block), chamfered flattened-hexagon section,

wings two stories high and stepped back, 16 hangar mouths and 8 frigate mouths, dorsal trench, low island over the Keep, 52 Ballista turrets (22 per flank), Escort Dock and slip doors, five drives in an X.

Chosen to fit (not stated in the spec): exact collar and engine-block section sizes, wing heights on the flank, chamfer proportions, turret and mouth spacing, cargo-bay door height. Radiators shown stowed.
